svg.title: 33 by 36 mm FPGA100T native placement study: front and mirrored back
svg.text: 33 × 36 mm · 12% less board area · all 128 parts retained
Compared with the 37.5 × 36 mm study; 17.5% smaller than the original 40 × 36 mm connector-fit study.
